You don't need a Microsoft account to use Windows 11. On an existing PC, go to Settings → Accounts → Your info and select "Sign in with a local account instead". This is Microsoft's own documented option, and you can switch back any time. Before you switch, back up your BitLocker recovery key. It's saved in your Microsoft account, and if Windows ever asks for it, your PC won't start without it.
